title: Input prices
private: This is your company's private data. Hoa Huy cannot see it and does not use it to calculate Hoa Huy's prices.
unavailable: Cannot reach Hoa Huy. Please try again in a few minutes.
name: Your supplier
ledgerHint: Enter only one per line: amount owed or paid. Entries can only be added, not edited or deleted.
archiveHint: Can only be deleted when the balance is 0. Only the supplier Admin can delete.

ok.subVendorAdded: Sub-supplier added. You can now pick it in the Sub-supplier column.
ok.archivedUnassigned: Items unassigned and the supplier deleted.

err.invalidLedger: Enter a date, a description and exactly one amount (owed or paid).
err.hasDebt: The balance is not zero, so it cannot be deleted yet.
err.unavailable: Cannot reach Hoa Huy. What you entered is still on screen; press the button again in a few minutes.
err.suspended: The supplier account is suspended. Please contact Hoa Huy.
err.failed: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
err.tooMany: Up to 200 codes can be saved at once. Save page by page.
err.subVendorGone: The chosen sub-supplier is no longer available. Reload the page and choose again.

byCode.search: Search by code or item name
byCode.empty: No item codes in purchase orders or quote requests yet.

unassign.title: Delete this sub-supplier?
unassign.effect: If you delete it, these items go back to "No sub-supplier chosen". Their input prices are kept; each change is recorded in the item's history. This supplier's debt balance is not changed.
